findings.evidence: Every delete_income failure (including the pending-account-deletion and not-own-income messages raised by the RPC) is shown as the same generic text.
findings.impact: A user whose account deletion is pending, or who hits a stale row, cannot tell why the delete failed.
findings.recommendation: Show the RPC error message (or map the known messages) instead of a fixed sentence.

findings.evidence: The migration redefines the whole purge_expired_account_deletion_requests body. Older migrations that also redefine it (MIGRATION_PG_CRON, R13, R35) would drop the incomes line if re-run later.
findings.impact: Low: incomes.user_id references auth.users ON DELETE CASCADE, and the purge deletes auth.users, so incomes are still removed.
findings.recommendation: Add the usual README warning that re-running an older purge-defining migration requires re-running R93 (as done for R35).
